events.title: Luminons | Live Developer Gameplay – Steam Next
events.summary: Hey everyone!I'm Álvaro, the developer of Luminons!I'll be playing the demo live, showing you some of the game's features, exploring the forests, and hanging out for a while.If you have any questions about the game or its development, feel free to ask in the chat! I'll do my best to answer.Hope you enjoy Luminons, and thanks for stopping by!

events.title: Luminons Demo Update v0.2.0 is Here! New Creatures, New Features & More!
events.summary: Hey, Tamers!Steam Next Fest is just around the corner! I've been working on a new update for Luminons: Seeds of Starlight, bringing new creatures, features, and visual improvements.What's New in v0.2.0?New Player Menu: Access your Profile, Item Collections, Luminopedia, Tamers, and Calendar.Luminon Companions: Choose a Luminon to follow you on your adventures!
